scope: Pre-run confirmation dialogue inputs and regression references for complete pending-dialogue retrieval. Previously consumed LongMemEval-S histories; no independent benchmark score.

settings.query: Use queryProtocol for the three retrieval arms; all use the same source/range filters and generation retention.

selection: New confirmation dialogues use the first eight distinct single-session-user sources with answers <=70 characters, ordered by SHA256(seed:id), excluding prior six sources. Four prespecified cancellation, absence, multiple-clarification and answered-with-question controls reuse those new sources. All sources were consumed by prior whole-500 work; this is a fresh dialogue cohort, not an independent benchmark.

queryProtocol.pending-user-inputs: All pending user turns, each prefixed User: and separated by two newlines.
queryProtocol.pending-dialogue: All pending user and assistant turns, each prefixed User: or Assistant: and separated by two newlines.
queryProtocol.opening: Before a pending root exists, every arm searches the current input verbatim. Frozen assistant clarifications use controlled needs_clarification responses to open the state through native events.
queryProtocol.generation: Complete pending dialogue in native roles, native system/character settings, and only this query’s selected memory. No union of earlier memory snapshots.
queryProtocol.interpretation: Role labels are common to both contextual arms, isolating assistant-turn inclusion; the older v3 user-only query had no labels and is historical evidence.
queryProtocol.terminal: Read actual final provider request_status; answered and insufficient_evidence clear the pending root. Status is not a factual correctness certificate.

judge.method: Released full-question/reference judge for factual requests; frozen custom absence rubrics for missing account/serial number.
judge.status: Desired status and actual emitted status are recorded separately from answer correctness.

completionCriterion: Require all frozen cases to be reported. Full dialogue must preserve the twelve user-only regression outcomes and improve referent-dependent confirmation cases without unsupported facts/cancellation failures. Verify fresh-only memory at every native request and terminal status closure. No new cases after observing outcomes; stop on hard limits or cleanup failure. This phase does not establish general provider/streaming/mutation compatibility.
recordingNote: Original pre-run plan retained unchanged. Its scope, exact per-case queries, decisionGate and producer hash define this run; several inherited v2/v3 prose fields are stale. The post-run protocol audit independently verifies all 60 recorded final queries against the frozen turns/queries. This maintained lock describes the executed protocol.
